sources.excerpt: Crazy Tube Circuits Write a Review Write a Review × Crazy Tube Circuits Crazy Tube Circuits Ziggy V2 Rating * Select Rating 1 star (worst) 2 stars 3 stars (average) 4 stars 5 stars (best) Name Email * Review Subject * Comments * Options Current Stock: $229.00 MSRP: You save Quantity: Decrease Quantity: Increase Quantity: Or Info Info ,Shipping: Info SKU: UPC: MPN: Shipping: Free Shipping Description The Crazy Tube Circuits Ziggy v2 is a British flavored dual overdrive / distortion designed with discreet MOSFET gain stages to respond like a tube amp with ultra touch sensitivity so that you can control everything from your guitar’s volume knob and pick attack. A silent relay true-bypass switching circuit selects between 2 separate overdrive/distortion channels – low and high gain - each with its own controls for ultimate versatility. Low gain channel is voiced after late 60s Super Bass while high gain channel sounds and responds like a late 70s Master Volume British amp. Gain knobs on both channels also act as voicing controls adding more bass as you turn clockwise, choosing from jangly and sparkling clean to thick crunch while tone knobs behave as a presence control adding bite to your tone. An internal circuitry provides 18V DC from a standard 9V DC power supply to ensure maximum headroom and tube like response. sources.excerpt: SKU: OQH9491213209 Category: Guitar pedal $167.70 $83.85 In stock Crazy Tube Circuits Ziggy V2 Overdrive/Distortion Pedal quantity Add to cart Description Authentic British amp tones in a compact pedal. TheZiggy V2 by Crazy Tube Circuits captures the essence of British-voiced tube amplifiers, delivering dynamic overdrive that ranges from mild breakup to full-stack saturation. Featuring two independent gain stages, Ziggy allows seamless transitions between crunchy rhythm tones and soaring lead gain, making it a versatile drive pedal for any setup. Key Features Dual Gain Stages Two distinct circuits inspired by legendary British amps: Low-Gain Channel Voiced after a late '60s Super Bass, offering warm, dynamic overdrive with rich harmonic content. High-Gain Channel Modeled after a late '70s Master Volume British amp, delivering tight, saturated distortion with enhanced midrange presence. MOSFET Gain Stages Designed to respond like a tube amp, providing ultra touch sensitivity for expressive playing. Voicing Controls The Gain knobs on both channels also act as voicing controls, adding more bass as you turn clockwise, allowing for jangly cleans to thick crunch. Presence Control The Tone knobs behave as a presence control, adding bite and clarity to the signal. Internal Voltage Boost Converts 9V to 18V DC, ensuring maximum headroom and tube-like response. True Bypass Switching Maintains signal integrity when disengaged. Specifications Power Requirement : 9V DC center-negative (internally converts to 18V) Circuit Type : Analog Gain Stages : Low Gain & High Gain Controls : Volume Adjusts output level. Gain Sets drive intensity and voicing. Tone Functions as a presence control. Bypass Type : True Bypass Dimensions : 72 x 118 x 50 mm You may also like
